### Colors  
- **Background**: Original has a yellow gradient; rendered has a solid light beige.  
- **Button**: Original uses a dark blue button with yellow text; rendered uses a dark blue button with yellow text + arrow icon.  
- **Text**: Original text is dark gray; rendered text is darker (near-black).  


### Typography  
- **Title**: Original uses a large, light gray "About"; rendered uses a larger, bold dark gray "About".  
- **Subhead**: Original uses "Our Story" (light gray); rendered uses "Our Story" (darker gray).  
- **Body Text**: Original has shorter, lighter gray paragraphs; rendered has longer, darker gray paragraphs.  


### Spacing & Layout  
- **Image**: Original has a full rock-climbing image; rendered has a cropped/placeholder image with a "12+ YEARS ON THE TRAIL" badge.  
- **Content Flow**: Original has text → image → text → button; rendered has image (left) → text (right) → badge → button.  
- **Additional Elements**: Rendered adds a navigation bar, stats section (30k+, 120+, etc.), footer (contact info, policies, social icons) — all absent in the original.  


### Key Missing/Added Elements  
- Original lacks navigation, stats, footer; rendered includes them.  
- Original has a single "Learn More" button; rendered has "LEARN MORE" with an arrow.
